todos: [P2] OLLAMA-THINKING-GPTOSS-LIVE-01: GPT-OSS was absent from the configured Ollama host on 2026-09-23 (rechecked at the end of that session: the local 127.0.0.1:11434 inventory holds only qwen, llama3.2, medgemma, moondream and embedding models). When available, re-read the configured host and model inventory, verify its actual family/capabilities and app behavior, confirm Settings shows only the level-only compatibility note (no false off switch), and confirm the runtime remains usable with the documented think:false default. Unit coverage is complete; this live check is still pending.

[P2] LIVE-EXECUTION-BUDGET-01: the first instrumented npm run test:live (2026-09-23, qwen2.5-coder:7b) passed 8/11 scenarios; the 3 failures (full task run, TS2305 export recovery, uninstallable dependency recovery) were all stopped by execution_budget after its single correction, on repeated failing `npm run build`/`npm install` (guards: execution_budget:advise then execution_budget:stop). Next, inspect those snapshots under Desktop/onlyrag_live_snapshots and decide, model-agnostically, whether a failing command whose output changed between attempts should reset or extend the budget in electron/core/domain/agent/agentProgressPolicy.ts (PROGRESS_BUDGET), then rerun npm run test:live and npm run test:e2e:electron (guard 2/4 must still stop).

[P3] FORMAT-BASELINE-01: 466 of 693 files drift from biome.json formatting because quality:static formats only newly added files. Next, land one formatting-only commit (npx biome format --write src electron shared scripts), then make check_static_quality.mjs format-check every file.

[P3] HTTP-METRICS-SURFACE-OR-REMOVE-01: httpMetrics is recorded by webClient, ollamaHttpClient and agentStreamTransport but nothing reads it since the unused diagnostics:get-http-metrics IPC was removed; next, either show it in DiagnosticsDrawer or delete electron/core/infrastructure/http/httpMetrics.ts, its record() call sites, diagnosticsAppService.getHttpMetrics and their tests.

[P3] DOCUMENTS-LIST-PAYLOAD-01: GET /documents returns the full extracted_markdown of every document and useIngestedDocuments refetches it on every window focus and tab change; next, return metadata only from the list and load a document's markdown on demand (chat context, attach, translation).

[P3] SIDECAR-TRANSLATION-CANCEL-01: the translation stream has no task_id or cooperative cancellation (ingestion does); next, add task_id to TranslateInplaceRequest, check raise_if_cancelled between PDF pages/DOCX batches in sidecar/domain/translator.py, and wire cancellation from sidecarHttpClient.translateDocumentInplaceStream.

[P3] I18N-HARDCODED-STRINGS-01: ~30 hardcoded Italian UI strings remain in src (e.g. AppLayout.tsx, ChatView.tsx, useCodingAgent.ts), 14 in Main core services, and sidecar progress/chunk-prefix text is Italian-only (the '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' prefix is also embedded); next, move UI strings to src/i18n locales and make sidecar progress messages locale-neutral codes.

[P3] MODEL-FALLBACK-CONSISTENCY-01: hardcoded model fallbacks disagree: 'qwen2.5-coder:7b' in agentInterviewAppService.ts, agentOrchestratorPromptAssembly.ts, agentOrchestratorSessionContext.ts, planGenerationAppService.ts versus 'llama3.2' in agentOrchestratorSessionSetup.ts::buildDefaultAgentSettings and ollamaHttpClient.ts, and 'qwen2.5-coder:7b' again in src/hooks/codingAgent/useCodingAgentExecution.ts (activeModel), while DEFAULT_APP_SETTINGS.defaultModel is ''. The Markdown translator already fails with translation.noModelConfigured instead of guessing (2026-09-23). Next, resolve a missing model in one shared function that fails with a clear 'no model configured' error instead of guessing a model that may not be installed.

[P3] RENDERER-PERF-01: ChatView.tsx renders messages without virtualization while useChatEngine re-maps the whole list every 40 ms during streaming; DiagnosticsDrawer polls full logs every 2.5 s with key={index}; PromptConfigurationModal tokenizes the whole draft on every keystroke and tokenEstimate.ts caches up to 1000 full drafts; monacoTheme.ts imports all of monaco-editor (ts.worker 6.9 MB). Next, memoize/virtualize the chat list, cap the token cache by size, debounce the token label, and load only the Monaco languages in use; verify with npm run test:e2e:bundle-ux.

[P3] LINT-STRICTNESS-01: biome.json lint uses preset none (only correctness + 3 suspicious rules); there are ~327 `any` in Main and ~130 in the renderer (97 are `catch (err: any)`), plus two inert `eslint-disable` comments (ESLint is not installed) in useAgentTimelineScroll.ts and useSkillHubModal.ts. After FORMAT-BASELINE-01, enable noExplicitAny as a warning, replace `catch (err: any)` with unknown + errorNormalizer, and delete the eslint-disable comments.

[P3] TOOLING-TYPECHECK-SCOPE-01: tsconfig.json includes scripts/live but not scripts/e2e, so scripts/e2e/sidecarOwnership.live.ts is never typechecked; vitest.sidecar.config.mts lacks the '@' alias used by the other configs. Next, add scripts/e2e to tsconfig include (fixing any errors) and align the config.

[P3] SIDECAR-DEAD-PATHS-01: after the 2026-09-23 endpoint cleanup, VocabSyncService's remote path (allow_remote=True, raw.githubusercontent.com manifest) is reachable only from tests, and process_and_index_document_generator still carries the upload-bytes branch (content/EXPORT_DIR caching) although every caller passes a file path with empty content. Next, remove both paths and their tests, keep bundled vocabulary loading, and regenerate the OpenAPI contract if schemas change.

[P3] SIDECAR-ERROR-DETAIL-01: sidecar/main.py still answers several 500s with HTTPException(detail=str(e)) (ingest-path-stream start, PUT /documents, page preview, delete, history index, export, logs analyze), which can include local paths. The API is now token-protected, so the exposure is limited to Main; next, return a generic message with the error_id used by global_exception_handler and log the detail.

[P3] IPC-PLAN-CONTRACT-01: after the 2026-09-23 IPC contract audit, `agent:plan-generate` still validates previousPlan with a passthrough schema (formatVersion, id, version, prompt, objective) while planGenerationAppService reads previousPlan.milestones and previousPlan.retainedEvidence without checks, and `projects:migrate-legacy` stores unknown keys of accepted legacy projects. PlanMilestone is also declared twice (shared/types/index.ts and shared/domain/agent/planMilestone.ts). Next, add a complete AgentPlan schema next to planMilestoneSchema in electron/core/domain/agent/agentTaskContract.ts and parse it in agentIpc.ts, strip unknown project keys in projectRegistryAppService.migrateLegacyProjects, keep one PlanMilestone type, and add negative tests in agentIpc.test.ts.

[P3] ARCH-PORTS-FOLLOWUP-01: after ARCH-LAYERING-01 (2026-09-23) application/domain no longer import electron or node:fs (enforced by scripts/check_layering.mjs), but electron/core/presentation/diagnosticsIpc.ts still calls runFullDiagnostics from electron/diagnostics.ts directly (skipping Application), application services import electron/diagnostics.ts for getCachedGpuInfo/getMemoryInfo/checkOllamaStatus instead of a hardware-probe port, TaskRunnerPort is declared in application/taskAppService.ts and ISkillHubAdapter in infrastructure/http/hubAdapters. Next, move the probes behind a domain port implemented in infrastructure, route diagnostics:run through diagnosticsAppService, move the two port interfaces to electron/core/domain/ports, and extend check_layering.mjs to forbid application imports of electron/diagnostics.ts.

[P3] TRANSLATION-INPLACE-LIFECYCLE-01: src/components/translation/TranslationView.tsx mounts InplaceTranslationPanel only while its tab is open, so switching back to the Markdown tab unmounts useInplaceTranslation, drops its status/progress and releases the 'translation' global task lock while the sidecar job keeps running; the two translators also keep separate language pairs. Next, lift the in-place job state (or keep the panel mounted and hidden) so the lock follows the sidecar job, share the language pair through useTranslationBase in src/hooks/useTranslation.ts, and cover tab switching during a job in a hook test. Related: SIDECAR-TRANSLATION-CANCEL-01.

[P3] TAUTOLOGICAL-TESTS-01: src/lib/frontendPerformance.test.ts re-implements the logic it claims to verify (e.g. 'Grep Search Out-Of-Order Request ID Invariant' simulates a request-id guard for the useGrepSearch hook deleted on 2026-09-23) instead of importing production code, so it cannot fail when the product regresses. Next, audit that file and similar simulation tests, rewrite them against the real hooks/services or delete them, and update the fast-suite counts in AGENTS.md.

[P3] GUARD-STOP-STATUS-01: in the E2E guard scenarios a run stopped by a guard (model_silence, execution_budget, step_budget, no_mutation) without an operational plan closes as completionStatus 'unverifiable', the same status as an honest finish without behavioral proof; only open or failed milestones make it 'blocked'. Next, decide in electron/core/application/agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts whether any ApplicationClosureRequest with a stopping guard should close as 'blocked', update the four guard scenarios in scripts/e2e/agentReliability.mjs and docs/agent.md.

[P3] TOOL-POLICY-GUARD-EVENTS-01: calls refused by the phase tool policy ('Tool blocked by current phase') consume steps but are not recorded as guard events and do not count toward any progress budget, so a model that keeps calling a blocked tool only ends on the step budget. Next, add a tool_policy AgentGuardId, record it where the phase policy rejects a call, and decide whether it should feed AgentProgressPolicy (e.g. as a loop block).
